data.one_liner: Load and cache network images in Flutter with placeholder and error widget support.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter library that shows images from the internet and keeps them cached in the local directory. It supports placeholders, error widgets, progress indicators, and custom image builders.
use_when: You need to display network images with local caching
You want custom loading placeholders or error widgets while images download
avoid_when: You are targeting the web platform where caching is currently not supported by this package
strengths: Easy integration for caching network images
Supports placeholders, error widgets, and progress indicators
weaknesses: Minimal support for web without caching capabilities

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive set of image processing and manipulation utilities rather than just caching network images.

data.minimal_example:
CachedNetworkImage(
        imageUrl: "http://via.placeholder.com/350x150",
        placeholder: (context, url) => CircularProgressIndicator(),
        errorWidget: (context, url, error) => Icon(Icons.error),
     )
